items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 42:1
items.html: (To the question) For these Mochin of the posterior come only by the inclusion of the Hod of AA in his Netzach, as above in Answer 6, when the Nukva Rachel became like the aspect of the Nukva in the body of ZA, namely the aspect of the Malchut of Netzach, see there. Therefore the diminishment of the moon was on the fourth day, which is Netzach. (Item 18).
